prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return CommonJS module solution.js.
Required API: exports.runSession = function(events)
Behavior: Start in closed. Legal transitions are closed/open -> open, open/authenticate -> ready, ready/ping -> ready, and open or ready/close -> closed. Reject the whole sequence on any other event/state pair; otherwise return the final state.
Visible example: [open, authenticate, ping, close] returns closed; [open, ping] is rejected.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

known_bad.code: exports.runSession=e=>{let s='closed';for(const x of e){if(x==='open')s='open';else if(x==='authenticate')s='ready';else if(x==='close')s='closed'}return s}
known_bad.label: ignores-illegal-transitions

reference.code: exports.runSession=e=>{let s='closed';for(const x of e){const k=s+':'+x;if(k==='closed:open')s='open';else if(k==='open:authenticate')s='ready';else if(k==='open:close'||k==='ready:close')s='closed';else if(k!=='ready:ping')return null}return s}
reference.label: author-reference
